subject: Cross-timezone contingency: IC3 ML onsite panel overlap and backup roster
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Talent Partner <recruiter@talentlane.co>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Cross-timezone contingency: IC3 ML onsite panel overlap and backup roster

Team — quick heads-up: we’ve got Sana Rao’s IC3 ML panel on Thursday (Dec 3) starting 09:00 PT. Two of our original panelists are now double-booked due to a product review that expanded; Laura and Vivek, you both overlap with one of the blocks. Candidate is high-priority and on a tight schedule (recruiter flagged potential accept window).

Can we confirm coverage and a contingency plan so we don’t have to reschedule? Specific asks: 
- Who can pick up the 10:00–11:00 PT deep-dive if Laura must stay for the review?
- Can someone be on standby to join the debrief immediately after the interview (11:15 PT)? We want a 20–30 minute calibrated debrief to capture signals while fresh.
- I’ve attached the candidate resume and a quick roster (IC3_Deconflict_Roster_v2.xlsx). If you take a slot, reply with the bullet list of what you’ll assess (technical scope / system design / collaboration).

I’ll coordinate with Talent Partner to lock a short backup interviewer in case of a last-minute conflict. If we can’t fill within the team, I’ll escalate to the EMs.

Thanks — David

--
David Kim
Senior Recruiting Partner (Technical Hiring)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SanaRao_Resume.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: IC3_Deconflict_Roster_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-timezone contingency: IC3 ML onsite panel overlap and backup roster

David — I can cover the 10:00–11:00 PT deep-dive if Laura needs to stay. I’ll focus on model evaluation (benchmarks, eval methodology) and system constraints (latency/cost tradeoffs). Bullet checklist: 
- Model comparison questions (recent evals, failure modes)
- Prompt/serving design for scaling (batching, cache strategies)
- Tradeoffs in quantization and latency budgets

I’ll plan to jump into the debrief at 11:15 PT. I also saved a copy of the debrief form here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qX-debrief-form — I’ll complete the signal matrix during the call so we have a shared reference.

If Vivek is willing to be on standby for a quick calibration call (10 minutes) after 11:45 PT, that covers us if anything runs late.

— Grace
Senior ML Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-timezone contingency: IC3 ML onsite panel overlap and backup roster

Thanks — appreciate the heads-up. Product review got extended; I can still make 09:00–09:45 PT but need to drop from the 10:00 block. Grace — great that you can pick up the deep-dive.

Two notes: 
1) I uploaded an annotated resume with suggested probes (see attachment: SanaRao_Resume.pdf) — I recommend prioritizing inference-edge experience and recent latency optimization work.
2) If we need a backup interviewer who hasn’t been on the loop, could we pull Marcus Lin or a nearby EM? I’d prefer someone who can speak to on-call and production incidents. Marcus is on the east coast but said he’d help for urgent coverage last month.

I’ll be available for the debrief at 11:20 PT — can join remote.

— Laura
Staffing Manager, ML Hiring
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-timezone contingency: IC3 ML onsite panel overlap and backup roster

Confirmed — Grace will take 10:00–11:00 PT deep-dive; Laura will be 09:00–09:45 and can join debrief at 11:20 PT. I’ll be the named backup and can jump in at 10:30 PT if something goes sideways (calendar permitting). I’ll also prep two quick calibration bullets for the debrief:
- Signal expectations for production-readiness (test coverage, incident playbooks)
- Scoring weight (algorithmic maturity vs. systems ownership)

David — please confirm with Talent Partner that the candidate and panel get an updated invite with the backup interviewer (me) listed as Bcc, and that the Greenhouse interview packet is up-to-date. I’ll fill in the 10-min standby slot on the roster.

If no objections by 16:00 PT, I’ll mark everyone in the roster and confirm with Talent Partner.

Thanks — Vivek
Engineering Manager, Infra Serving
Redwood Inference
